title: Baqar Yateem Hogaye Sajjad Margaye
body:
Baqar(a.s) Yateem Hogaye Sajjad(a.s) Margaye
Bewea Janaabe dukhtar e shabbar(a.s) ko kargaye
1. Waris Bayaan karte hain ro ro ke raat din
Hum Bekasou'n ko chordh ke hazrath kidhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Duniya me koi puchne waala nahi raha
Kyun kar na hum jahaan se ya rab guzar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mar jaaye sarparast to kya lutfe zindagi
Hum Badnaseeb mout se pehle na margaye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Be wariso ka marna hi acch hai jeene se
Jab bekasi me monis o ghamkhwaar margaye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hazrat se koi puchta rone ka jab sabab
Kehte the hum yateem hue baap margaye
